landing.title: Your savings circle with family and friends, no mix-ups
landing.pitch: Organize the group, set turns and dates, and see who has paid and who has not, all in one place.
landing.point1: A clear order of turns for everyone
landing.point3: A transparent record of every payment
landing.noMoneyNotice: The app never holds or moves money. All payments happen directly between you; the app only records and confirms them.
